metadata.description: Single-plugin marketplace for the rag-your-code local codebase RAG index.

plugins.name: rag-your-code
plugins.description: Local, explainable codebase RAG for coding agents. Indexes functions, methods and classes across Python and 14 other languages with no network calls and no runtime dependencies; every result carries a file, a line range, its matched terms and its source. Adds bounded graph expansion over calls/imports/contains edges and a JSON-lines agent protocol.
